title: 植物组织培养
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/179_植物组织培养.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/179_植物组织培养/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶长着绿色小苗的组培瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small glass culture jar with a tiny green plantlet growing on clear gel medium, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十七课：植物组织培养。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一根胡萝卜，准备直接切了放进培养瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a whole carrot and a kitchen knife over an open culture jar on an ordinary bench, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起胡萝卜，就想切块放进瓶。

shots.scene: 一周后瓶里长满了绒毛状霉菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a culture jar full of fuzzy white mold covering a carrot piece, a sad face icon. No text.
shots.narration: 一周后，瓶里长满了霉。

shots.scene: 小研：先消毒、无菌接种，刀也要拿稳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and gloves points to a clean bench with sterile tools and a covered dish of carrot discs.
shots.narration: 小研：消毒、无菌接种，一步不能少。

shots.scene: 王老师递给他一份组培实验方案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a plant tissue culture protocol sheet and points to a clean bench. The sheet is blank.
shots.narration: 王老师：先读方案，再上超净台。

shots.scene: 导入新基因，还要长成新植株
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single plant cell with a new gene icon growing step by step into a whole small plant. No text.
shots.narration: 细胞有了新基因，还得长成新植株。

shots.scene: 组织培养：试管里离体培养
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small piece of plant tissue on gel medium inside a test tube, growing shoots, a whole plant icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 组织培养也叫微繁殖，在试管里离体培养。

shots.scene: 一个细胞能再生整株植物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one plant cell with an arrow to a full plant, a totipotency star icon. No text.
shots.narration: 理论上，一个细胞就能长成整株植物。

shots.scene: 组培用于快繁、育种和转基因再生
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, rows of identical seedlings, a breeding cross icon and a gene icon leading to a regenerated plant. No text.
shots.narration: 快速繁殖、育种、转基因再生都靠它。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜直根，培育克隆苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a carrot taproot with stored energy icons, several identical small carrot plantlets next to it. No text.
shots.narration: 用胡萝卜直根，能培育一模一样的克隆苗。

shots.scene: 组织太小，营养全靠培养基
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny tissue piece on a large medium plate, arrows of nutrients flowing from the medium into the tissue. No text.
shots.narration: 组织很小，生长所需全靠培养基。

shots.scene: 蔗糖、维生素、激素、琼脂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four ingredient icons, a sugar cube, a vitamin capsule, a hormone droplet and a gel block, around a medium jar. No text.
shots.narration: 蔗糖供碳源，维生素护苗，琼脂凝固。

shots.scene: 激素促进分裂和生长
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hormone droplet making plant cells divide and enlarge, arrows showing growth. No text.
shots.narration: 激素促进细胞分裂、增大和分化。

shots.scene: 按方案配制，瓶上写清内容日期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a medium bottle with a blank label and a pen, a protocol sheet beside it with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 按实验方案配制，瓶上标清名称日期。

shots.scene: 称量激素和试剂，先查SDS
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves weighs a small amount of powder on a balance, a safety data sheet document beside her.
shots.narration: 称激素和试剂，先查SDS，戴好防护。

shots.scene: 用酸碱调pH，防溅
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands adding drops from a dropper bottle into a medium beaker on a stirrer, goggles on, a pH meter probe in the beaker.
shots.narration: 用酸碱调pH，戴护目镜防溅。

shots.scene: 培养基和器械高压灭菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: medium jars and wrapped tools loaded into an autoclave, a pressure gauge icon and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 培养基、器械高压灭菌，按规程操作。

shots.scene: 取出防烫，热琼脂别溅手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heat resistant gloves taking hot medium bottles out of an autoclave after pressure returns to zero, a burn icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 压力归零再开门，戴隔热手套防烫。

shots.scene: 灭菌后在超净台内分装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sterilized medium poured into culture jars inside a clean bench, lids closed, jars stored on a clean shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 灭菌后在超净台内分装，盖好存放。

shots.scene: 活组织哪个部位都能用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plant with highlighted parts, shoot tip, young leaf, root tip, flower bud, seed and fruit. No text.
shots.narration: 只要是活组织，哪个部位都能用。

shots.scene: 茎尖、分生组织、嫩叶成功率高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the shoot tip, meristem and young leaf marked with stars, other parts marked plain. No text.
shots.narration: 茎尖、分生组织、嫩叶，成功率最高。

shots.scene: 从性状优良的母株取材
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a healthy strong mother plant with a check mark next to a weak sickly plant crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 从性状优良、健康的母株上取材。

shots.scene: 材料先去掉老叶和泥土
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plant part trimmed of old leaves and soil before washing, waste in a bin. No text.
shots.narration: 取材后先去掉老叶、泥土和伤损部分。

shots.scene: 先用肥皂和清水洗净
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands scrubbing a carrot under running water with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 外植体先用肥皂和流水洗净。

shots.scene: 【实拍】超净台内乙醇浸、消毒液泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up inside a clean bench of tweezers moving carrot pieces from a short dip in an alcohol beaker into a jar of disinfectant solution.
shots.narration: 超净台内，乙醇浸一下，再泡消毒液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】无菌水冲洗几遍
shots.prompt_en: Close-up inside a clean bench of carrot pieces rinsed in a jar of sterile water, the water poured into a waste beaker, repeated.
shots.narration: 再用无菌水冲洗几遍，去掉消毒液。

shots.scene: 次氯酸钠有腐蚀性，不与酸混
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bleach bottle with a corrosive icon, mixing it with an acid bottle releasing a toxic gas cloud, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 次氯酸钠有腐蚀性，不能和酸混合。

shots.scene: 戴手套护目镜，废液按规定收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: goggles and gloves icons, used disinfectant poured into a labeled waste container, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 戴手套护目镜，废液按规定收集。

shots.scene: 超净台里乙醇别靠近火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol beaker inside a clean bench kept far from a burner, an alcohol spray drifting into a flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 乙醇易燃，台内有火时别喷别倒。

shots.scene: 【实拍】打孔器在胡萝卜段中取芯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands pressing a metal cork borer straight down into a thick carrot slice on a sterile dish, fingers kept clear.
shots.narration: 打孔器垂直下压，手指别挡在下面。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在无菌皿里切薄片，刀口向外
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands slicing a carrot core into thin discs on a sterile petri dish with a scalpel, cutting away from the body.
shots.narration: 在无菌皿里切片，刀口朝外不对人。

shots.scene: 刀片不用手装卸，进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scalpel blade removed with a blade remover tool and dropped into a sharps container, bare fingers crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 刀片用工具装卸，用完进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 器械灭菌：热珠灭菌器防烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tweezers placed into an electric glass bead sterilizer and set aside to cool, an alcohol jar next to a flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 器械按规程灭菌，烫的放凉再用。

shots.scene: 酒精缸远离火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol soaking jar for tools placed far from a burner flame, a flame reaching the jar crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 泡器械的酒精缸，远离明火。

shots.scene: 细胞增殖成愈伤组织
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cells on a carrot disc multiplying into an irregular pale cell mass. No text.
shots.narration: 细胞增殖成一团无序的愈伤组织。

shots.scene: 换含生长素的培养基诱导分化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the callus moved to a new medium jar with a hormone droplet icon, small roots and shoots appearing. No text.
shots.narration: 转到含生长素的新培养基，诱导分化。

shots.scene: 长出根和芽，成为小植株
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a callus with tiny roots below and tiny shoots above, then a small plantlet. No text.
shots.narration: 又过几周，长出根和芽，叫小植株。

shots.scene: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tissue piece placed on medium inside a clean bench, developing small embryo like clusters. No text.
shots.narration: 第一步：取材上培养基，诱导胚状体。

shots.scene: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cluster separated into single embryo like structures, each moved to a new rooting medium jar. No text.
shots.narration: 第二步：分开胚状体，转到生根培养基。

shots.scene: 第三步：成苗，驯化后移栽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plantlets growing in jars, then in a controlled growth chamber, then planted in a pot outside. No text.
shots.narration: 第三步：成苗，先驯化，再移栽。

shots.scene: 每次转接都在超净台内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three arrows from jar to jar, each passing through a clean bench icon. No text.
shots.narration: 每一次转接，都在超净台内无菌完成。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜组培用同一套无菌方法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean bench with sterile tools, a fern culture icon and a carrot icon sharing the same tool set. No text.
shots.narration: 胡萝卜组培，用同一套无菌方法。

shots.scene: 洗净、切段、取芯、切片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, a washed carrot, cut into segments, a core removed with a borer, the core sliced into thin discs. No text.
shots.narration: 洗净切段，取芯切成薄片。

shots.scene: 【实拍】镊子把圆片放到培养基上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up inside a clean bench of sterile tweezers placing a thin carrot disc onto gel medium in a jar, the lid replaced quickly.
shots.narration: 无菌镊子把圆片放上培养基，马上盖好。

shots.scene: 瓶上标记，放进培养室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: culture jars with blank labels placed on shelves of a growth room under lamps. No text.
shots.narration: 标好名称日期，放进培养室。

shots.scene: 几周后长出愈伤组织
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar of a few weeks and a carrot disc gradually covered with pale callus. No text.
shots.narration: 几周后，圆片上长出愈伤组织。

shots.scene: 愈伤、生根生芽、长成新株
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a timeline from a carrot disc to callus, to roots and shoots, to a new carrot plantlet. No text.
shots.narration: 愈伤，生根生芽，长成新植株。

shots.scene: 小苗挨得太近，要分株
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crowded cluster of plantlets in one jar, an arrow to separated single plantlets in several jars. No text.
shots.narration: 小苗挤成一簇，要无菌分株。

shots.scene: 【实拍】分株仍要无菌，工具先消毒
shots.prompt_en: Close-up inside a clean bench of sterile tweezers and scalpel gently separating plantlets on a sterile dish.
shots.narration: 分株也在超净台内，工具先灭菌。

shots.scene: 炼苗后移到无土基质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plantlets hardened gradually under a cover, then moved into pots of soilless growing medium. No text.
shots.narration: 炼苗后移到无土基质，需要时再分。

shots.scene: 苗长到合适高度再分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plantlet next to a height mark, separated when it reaches the mark, a check. No text.
shots.narration: 苗长到合适高度再分，更容易成活。

shots.scene: 调控温度、光照、营养、激素
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growth chamber with temperature, light, nutrient and hormone icons around culture jars on shelves. No text.
shots.narration: 温度、光照、营养、激素都要调控。

shots.scene: 定时查看，记录温度、pH、光照
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks a growth room and writes in a logbook, a thermometer and a light timer icon beside him. The logbook is blank.
shots.narration: 定时查看，记录温度、pH和光照时长。

shots.scene: 用灯光，不晒太阳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: culture jars under grow lamps checked, jars in direct sunlight by a window crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 阳光直晒会杀死培养物，要用灯光。

shots.scene: 设备异常及时报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growth chamber with a warning light and an overheating icon, a person reporting to a teacher. No text.
shots.narration: 温控光照异常，及时报告老师。

shots.scene: 杂菌也爱这样的环境
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warm, sweet medium jar attracting bacteria and mold icons from the air. No text.
shots.narration: 细菌和真菌也爱这样的环境。

shots.scene: 黏滑多是细菌，绒毛多是真菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two jars, one with a slimy shiny patch marked bacteria, one with fuzzy growth marked fungi. No text.
shots.narration: 黏滑的多是细菌，绒毛状的多是真菌。

shots.scene: 定期检查，全程无菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with regular check marks and a magnifier over culture jars on a shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查，全程保持无菌。

shots.scene: 污染了，回头查原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a checklist of steps, explant washing, sterile tools, medium sterilization and bench cleaning. No text.
shots.narration: 出现污染，回头查消毒和操作环节。

shots.scene: 污染瓶不开盖，报告后灭菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moldy culture jar kept closed, put into an autoclave bag, then into an autoclave, an opening hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 污染瓶不开盖，报告后高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 实验室的胡萝卜不能吃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a carrot in the lab with a mouth icon crossed out, a no food or drink sign beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室的胡萝卜，再新鲜也不能吃。

shots.scene: 转基因植株不带走、不乱扔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transgenic plantlet jar kept in a designated growth room, a student carrying it home crossed out, a trash bin crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 转基因材料不带出，灭活后按规定处置。

shots.scene: 废培养基灭菌后处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used medium jars put into an autoclave, then emptied and the jars washed, a sink with solid gel crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 废培养基灭菌后处置，不倒进水槽。

shots.scene: 少量组织，大量繁殖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one small tissue piece multiplying into rows of many identical plantlets. No text.
shots.narration: 优点：少量组织就能大量繁殖，更快。

shots.scene: 稀有难繁殖，也能得无病苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rare plant icon and a healthy virus free plantlet with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 难繁殖的也能用，还能得到无病苗。

shots.scene: 缺点：费钱费工，可能突变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an expensive equipment icon, a skilled hands icon and a mutation icon on a plantlet. No text.
shots.narration: 缺点：设备技能要求高，可能突变。

shots.scene: 早期脆弱，难适应正常环境
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fragile young plantlet wilting outside a protected chamber, a shield icon around another one. No text.
shots.narration: 早期很脆弱，可能适应不了正常环境。

shots.scene: 扬长避短，按需选用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance scale with advantages on one side and costs on the other, a thinking icon. No text.
shots.narration: 权衡优缺点，按需要选用组培。

shots.scene: 培养基灭菌，外植体消毒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave icon and a carrot piece in a disinfectant jar, both checked. No text.
shots.narration: 培养基灭菌，外植体消毒再接种。

shots.scene: 愈伤、分化、分株、驯化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a callus, roots and shoots, separated plantlets and a potted plant in a row. No text.
shots.narration: 愈伤、分化、分株、驯化移栽。

shots.scene: 刀具小心，污染瓶不开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scalpel going into a sharps box and a closed moldy jar going into an autoclave. No text.
shots.narration: 刀具小心，污染瓶灭菌，材料不外带。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手抱着一台显微镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot carries a light microscope with one hand on the arm and the other under the base, nodding goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：光学显微镜的使用。
